test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

He clarified that he wasn’t the one to send the controversial news to the newspaper

options.text: He said, "I am not the one to send the controversial news to the newspaper."
He said, "He hadn’t been the one to send the controversial news to the newspaper."
He said, "I wasn’t the one to send the controversial news to the newspaper."
He said, "He wasn’t the one to send the controversial news to the newspaper."

solution:
The correct answer is **'He said, "I am not the one to send the controversial news to the newspaper."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **indirect speech **and we need to convert it to **direct speech.**
 
• When we change **an indirect speech to direct speech**, we use the following rules - 
 
 
• The **reporting verb clarified **is changed to **said**. 
 
• The **conjunction that **is replaced with **inverted commas ("...") **to show the direct speech. 
 
• A **comma (,) **is added before the direct speech part. 
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in *capital letter. *
 
• The **verb (wasn't)** is changed to its **present tense form am not.** 
 
• The **pronoun he **is changed from **second person **to **first person I. **
 
 
 
• So, by following the above rules, we get the direct speech as - He said, "I am not the one to send the controversial news to the newspaper."

Thus, **option 1 **is the correct answer.
